meta.group_input_shape: serialized — one textarea property per repeatable table, holding a JSON array of row objects. NOT one property per slot: that shape needs 452 properties for this form against 366 free against HubSpot's 1,000-custom-property ceiling, and property names cannot be withdrawn.
meta.naming_rule: irs<form>_<map input key>, lowercase throughout. HubSpot silently lowercases stored names, so a mixed-case definition drifts from the portal permanently.
